{{Top|leg}}
'''Dangleberry juice''' was a drink made by [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] consisting of the juice of [[Dangleberry|dangleberries]], which grew on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. The Ewoks made the drink by squeezing the fluids from dangleberries hanging in trees into buckets when dangleberries bloomed once a year, with the Ewok [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket]] remarking that he felt that making the juice was work for Woklings rather than warriors. The being known as the [[Totem Master]] appeared as the Ewoks were making the juice and asked them for a drink, and [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesa]] gave him a bucket of the fresh dangleberry juice, which he quickly gulped down, before giving the Ewoks a [[totem pole]] as a reward for the drink.<ref name="2-06">{{Ewoks|The Totem Master}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Dangleberry juice appeared in the season two ''[[Ewoks (television series)|Ewoks]]'' episode "The Totem Master".<ref name="2-06"></ref>
